newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht firms, interbank eases late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht firms, interbank eases late.

text.p: The Thai baht firmed late on Friday in response to measures taken so far to address instability in Thailand's financial system, dealers said.

The baht was quoted at 25.932-25.953 per dollar late on Friday against 25.948-25.970 earlier. The one month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 11.25/12.25 late against 11.50/12.00 earlier, dealers said.

"In the afternoon there was a lot more selling of dollars as the market became more settled in response to measures taken to help the finance sector. People feel the action might do some good," said a dealer at Siam Commercial Bank.

The Thai government has identified 10 weak finance firms which are required to increase capital, offered to guarantee finance company debt and imposed stringent new provisioning requirements on finance companies and banks.
The baht was helped in the afternoon by the range-bound dollar which weakened to 121.00-121.20 yen from 121.30 earlier.
But turbulence in the Thai financial sector meant market sentiment towards the baht remained fundamentally cautious, traders said.
"It still traded on the high side of the midrate because the market is nervous ahead of the Moody's review," a dealer said.
The Bank of Thailand set the daily midrate at 25.93.
The interbank overnight offered rate eased to 6.50-7.50 percent from 7.50-8.00 as money continued to flow from finance companies and into bank deposits, dealers said.

"Investors have transferred money from finance firms and into big banks, so the banks have got plenty of money. The inter finance rate is around five percent higher than the interbank but it seems manageable," she said.
